label: Cognee
notes: Self-hosted graph/RAG memory run as a pinned cognee/cognee image (single container, SQLite + LanceDB + Ladybug) on a loopback port in single-user mode (no authentication). Ingestion is asynchronous: the indexer adds documents, then requests cognify once per changed dataset, so a document is searchable only after the graph is built. Default cognify path is local GLiNER + FastEmbed (no API key); alternatives are LLM_PROVIDER=ollama or an OpenAI-compatible LLM_API_KEY. No coding-agent plugin — agents use the REST API on the loopback port (/docs).

wizardOwns: compose profile 'cognee', the loopback host port (COGNEE_PORT, default 8766) and the stack .env entries
GRAPH_EXTRACTOR / EMBEDDING_* (default GLiNER + FastEmbed) and optional LLM_* settings in cognee.env (mode 600, outside the repo)
the smoke test (health, dataset, multipart add, list, delete; recall is skipped because ingestion is asynchronous)
Cognee dataset mapping from indexer banks (the indexer sink maps each bank to a dataset)

codingAgent.notes: No plugin package. setupCodingAgent prints REST paths and registers the read-only Cognee MCP (cognee_health / cognee_search) in ~/.cursor/mcp.json.

wizard.retainBody: multipart/form-data: datasetName=wizard_smoke, data=wizard-smoke.md (done by the smoke hook)
wizard.recallHint: check {compose} logs cognee and cognify settings (GLiNER/FastEmbed, Ollama, or LLM_API_KEY)
